qpm.qtSearchPaths.description: Additional Qt base directories or kit roots scanned by Qt Project Manager.

qpm.activeQtInstallation.description: Selected Qt kit root, for example C:\Qt\6.8.3\mingw_64.

qpm.qtCompilerPath.description: Optional C++ compiler override dedicated to native Qt kits. Leave empty to auto-detect the matching compiler under the Qt installation Tools directory.

qpm.qtDesignerPath.description: Optional path to Qt Widgets Designer (designer.exe) or Qt Creator. Leave empty to auto-detect the launcher from the selected Qt kit.

qpm.qtDeployTranslations.description: Include Qt translation catalogs when deploying a native Qt target with the Qt deployment tool.

qpm.pythonExecutable.description: Optional Python executable used to serve WebAssembly output when qtwasmserver is unavailable.

qpm.autoLoadWorkspace.description: Automatically load a native .qtproject.json project or a .cws compatibility workspace when the opened VS Code folder contains exactly one candidate.

qpm.projectFormatVersion.description: Internal .cws/.prj format version used when generating new Qt Project Manager workspaces. Keep the default unless you need compatibility with a specific legacy parser.

qpm.showPersistentStatusBarActions.description: Show compact Qt Project Manager actions in the VS Code status bar. These actions remain available when the Qt Workspace view is collapsed.

qpm.autoConfigureCppTools.description: Automatically create and refresh the managed Qt Project Manager IntelliSense configuration and compile database when a native Qt project is created, opened or changed.

qpm.autoAddQpmFolderToWorkspace.description: Automatically add the precise native Qt project root as a VS Code workspace folder so Microsoft C/C++ loads the generated project-local IntelliSense configuration.

qpm.intelliSenseCompilerPath.description: Optional explicit compiler executable used by Microsoft Qt/C++ IntelliSense. Leave empty to use the selected gcc/g++/clang toolchain.

qpm.additionalIncludePaths.description: Additional include directories appended to the generated Qt/C++ IntelliSense configuration.

qpm.enableSupplementalCompletionProvider.description: Provide supplemental completion items parsed from active project sources only. Disabled by default to leave completion fully managed by Microsoft Qt/C++ and avoid extra work while typing.

qpm.enableStandardLibraryCompletionProvi.description: Provide lightweight completion items for common Qt/C++ standard-library symbols only when the matching header is not already included. This avoids duplicates with Microsoft Qt/C++ IntelliSense while still allowing auto-include insertion before the header exists.

qpm.standardLibraryCompletionAutoInclude.description: When a standard-library completion item is accepted, insert the required #include if it is missing from the current file.

qpm.buildMode.description: Build mode used by QPM. Native Qt projects default to 64-bit and are aligned with the selected kit architecture. Debug modes add -g -O0; release modes add -O2.
enumDescriptions: Debug, 64-bit: -g -O0 (and -m64 when architecture flags are enabled)
Release, 64-bit: -O2 (and -m64 when architecture flags are enabled)
Show phases, failures and the final summary only.
Recommended: show structured phases, per-tool status, parsed diagnostics and hints while keeping full command lines in the Build Trace output channel.
Also show full compiler commands and successful tool output in the main QPM output channel.
qpm.buildLogDetail.description: Controls how much information QPM shows in the main build log. Full raw commands/output are always preserved in the separate Qt Project Manager - Build Trace output channel.

qpm.installations.description: Known Qt/C++ toolchain root or bin directories detected or added manually.
qpm.installations.markdownDescription: Known Qt/C++ toolchain root or bin directories detected or added manually.

qpm.activeInstallation.description: Selected Qt/C++ toolchain root or bin directory. Leave empty to use automatic detection from PATH and common MinGW/MSYS2/Clang locations.

qpm.cCompilerPath.description: C compiler executable used by the generic build pipeline, for example gcc or an absolute MinGW gcc.exe path.

qpm.cppCompilerPath.description: C++ compiler and linker executable used by the generic build pipeline, for example g++ or an absolute MinGW g++.exe path.

qpm.archiverPath.description: Static-library archiver executable used for Static Library targets.

qpm.debuggerPath.description: GDB executable used when launching the VS Code cppdbg debugger.

qpm.outputDirectory.description: Directory, relative to the project file by default, used to store generic compiler objects and fallback targets.

qpm.cStandard.description: C language standard passed as -std=<value>. auto does not pass a C standard flag.

qpm.cppStandard.description: C++ language standard passed as -std=<value>. auto does not pass a C++ standard flag.

qpm.warningLevel.description: Predefined warning profile used by the generic GCC/MinGW build pipeline. none passes no warning flag; all adds -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Wconversion.

qpm.optimizationLevel.description: Optimization profile used by the generic build pipeline. mode-default uses -O0 for Debug and -O2 for Release.
enumDescriptions: -Ofast: aggressive, may break strict standard compliance

qpm.debugInformation.description: Debug-information profile used by the generic build pipeline. mode-default adds -g only for Debug configurations.

qpm.architectureMode.description: Architecture flag mode. auto uses the selected compiler default; from-build-mode maps Debug/Release to -m32 and Debug64/Release64 to -m64.

qpm.useBuildModeArchitectureFlags.description: When enabled, x86 modes add -m32 and x64 modes add -m64. Keep disabled if you select architecture by choosing a specific compiler path.

qpm.compilerFlags.description: Additional flags passed to both C and C++ compilation commands.

qpm.cCompilerFlags.description: Additional flags passed only to C compilation commands.

qpm.cppCompilerFlags.description: Additional flags passed only to C++ compilation commands.

qpm.linkerFlags.description: Additional flags passed to the final link command.

qpm.includePaths.description: Additional include directories. Relative paths are resolved from the project file directory.

qpm.libraryPaths.description: Additional library search directories passed as -L entries. Relative paths are resolved from the project file directory.

qpm.libraries.description: Additional libraries passed to the linker. Values may be names such as m/ws2_32 or complete -l flags.

qpm.useLocalBuildCacheForOneDrive.description: When the project is located under OneDrive and the normal object directory cannot be created, fall back to a local build cache for intermediate object files.

qpm.runArguments.description: Arguments passed to the active executable when running it.

qpm.runtimeDependencyMode.description: Generic toolchain runtime dependency handling for normal Qt builds. copy-dlls copies detected GCC/MinGW/MSYS2 and LLVM/Clang runtime DLLs beside the target; path-only prepends the selected toolchain bin directory to PATH for QPM run/debug; static-link injects GCC/Clang static runtime link flags when supported by the toolchain.
enumDescriptions: Copy the toolchain runtime DLLs beside the target
Use the toolchain through PATH at run/debug time
Link the GCC/Clang runtime statically when the toolchain supports it

qpm.deployRuntimeDlls.description: Legacy setting for toolchain runtime DLL deployment. Prefer qpm.runtimeDependencyMode.
qpm.deployRuntimeDlls.deprecationMessage: Use qpm.runtimeDependencyMode instead. Legacy auto maps to copy-dlls and never maps to path-only.

qpm.cleanRuntimeDllsOnDeploy.description: Before deploying toolchain runtime DLLs beside the target, remove stale or architecture-mismatched runtime DLLs managed by QPM from the target directory. This prevents x86/x64 runtime DLL mix-ups when switching build modes or toolchains.

qpm.qmlLintOnSave.description: Run the selected Qt kit qmllint tool whenever a managed QML file is saved.

qpm.qmlFormatOnSave.description: Run the selected Qt kit qmlformat tool in place whenever a managed QML file is saved.

qpm.qmlImportPaths.description: Additional project-relative or absolute QML import paths passed to qmllint, qmlformat preview and QML runtime tools.

qpm.qrcCreateBackups.description: Create a one-time .qpm-backup copy before the graphical Qt Resource Editor first rewrites a .qrc file.

qpm.translationOutputDirectory.description: Project-relative directory suggested when creating Qt Linguist .ts files.

qpm.translationSourceLanguage.description: Source-language locale passed to lupdate when creating or updating Qt translations.

qpm.translationFailOnUnfinished.description: Pass -fail-on-unfinished to lrelease so unfinished translations fail catalog generation.

qpm.testAutoRefresh.description: Refresh Qt Test, Qt Quick Test, GoogleTest, Catch2, Boost.Test and CTest discovery after managed test sources or CMake files change.

qpm.ctestPath.description: Optional path to CTest. Leave empty to use the active CMake/Qt kit or PATH.

qpm.clangTidyPath.description: Optional path to clang-tidy. Leave empty to search the selected Qt toolchain, Qt Tools/LLVM and PATH.

qpm.clazyPath.description: Optional path to clazy-standalone or clazy. Leave empty to search the Qt installation and PATH.

qpm.gcovPath.description: Optional path to gcov used by the Qt Test coverage profile. Leave empty to use the compiler toolchain gcov.

qpm.qmlProfilerPath.description: Optional qmlprofiler executable override. Leave empty to use the selected Qt kit.

qpm.valgrindPath.description: Optional Valgrind executable override used by Memcheck and Callgrind.

qpm.kcachegrindPath.description: Optional KCachegrind or QCachegrind executable override.

qpm.heobPath.description: Optional Heob executable override for Windows memory diagnostics.

qpm.sshExecutable.description: Optional SSH executable override used by Remote Linux platform profiles.

qpm.scpExecutable.description: Optional SCP executable override used by Remote Linux deployment.

qpm.rsyncExecutable.description: Optional rsync executable override used by Remote Linux synchronization.

qpm.androidSdkRoot.description: Optional Android SDK root. Leave empty to use ANDROID_HOME, ANDROID_SDK_ROOT or standard installation locations.

qpm.androidNdkRoot.description: Optional Android NDK root. Leave empty to use the NDK configured by the Android platform profile or the newest installed side-by-side NDK.

qpm.androidJdkRoot.description: Optional Java JDK root used by Gradle and Android packaging. Leave empty to use JAVA_HOME or Qt/Android Studio bundled JDK locations.

qpm.androidAdbPath.description: Optional path to adb. Leave empty to use Android SDK platform-tools.

qpm.androidEmulatorPath.description: Optional path to the Android emulator executable.

qpm.androidDeployQtPath.description: Optional path to androiddeployqt. Leave empty to use the selected Qt for Android kit.

qpm.sdlInstallations.description: Known SDL SDK root directories detected or added manually.

qpm.sdlRootPath.description: Selected SDL2/SDL3 SDK directory. This can be the SDK root, an architecture folder such as i686-w64-mingw32/x86_64-w64-mingw32, or a nested bin/lib/include/include\SDL2 folder. Leave empty to let QPM auto-scan common SDK roots when a project uses SDL.

qpm.sdlEnabled.description: SDL build integration mode. off disables SDL flags; auto injects SDL only for projects that include or call SDL; on always injects SDL for active builds.
enumDescriptions: Inject SDL only for projects that include or call SDL

qpm.sdlVersion.description: SDL major version used by the generic build pipeline. auto infers SDL2 or SDL3 from selected packages and source includes.
enumDescriptions: Infer SDL2 or SDL3 from packages and includes

qpm.sdlPackages.description: SDL packages linked by the generic build pipeline. SDL2 or SDL3 core is selected from qpm.sdlVersion; extension packages are added when selected and present in the SDK.

qpm.sdlRuntimeMode.description: How SDL runtime dependencies are handled. copy-dlls copies SDL2/SDL3 DLLs beside the executable; path-only prepends SDL bin to PATH at run/debug; static-link uses static SDL libraries when available.
enumDescriptions: Copy SDL DLLs beside the executable
Prepend the SDL bin directory to PATH at run/debug time
Link static SDL libraries when available

qpm.sdlSubsystem.description: Windows subsystem used for SDL executable linking. windows hides the console with -mwindows; console keeps terminal output visible with -mconsole.
enumDescriptions: -mconsole: keep the console for terminal output

qpm.sdlCopyAllRuntimeDlls.description: When SDL runtime mode is copy-dlls, copy every DLL from the SDL bin directory. This helps SDL_image, SDL_ttf and similar packages that may depend on companion DLLs.
